summary: Calling set_path("x") on Url::parse("file://") truncates serialization to path_start. The Windows drive-letter check then slices from path_start + 1, past the string's end, causing a panic. The fix guards the slice with serialization.len() > path_start. The fix adds the top-level regression test issue_864 in url/tests/unit.rs. Both selected regions occur exactly once; replacing the fixed region with the parent region exactly restores the parent implementation file. Tests were not run.
expected_failure: byte index 8 is out of bounds of `file://`
